title: Practice 2: об-: around — из-: all over

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Для вашего спокойствия я готов все магазины ___ (обегать / обегать — to run).
exercises.why: **обежа́ть** — **обега́ть** — to run around .mw-parser-output .object-usage-tag{font-style:italic}.mw-parser-output .deprecated{color:var(--wikt-palette-grey-lime-8,olivedrab)}[with accusative or вокру́г (vokrúg, + genitive) ‘a location’]; to run [with ми́мо (mímo, + genitive) ‘past a location’] (to bypass while running). **обнести́** — **обноси́ть** — to enclose (with); to serve (round). **обвести́** — **обводи́ть** — to lead (someone around); to encircle, to surround. — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  From Фёдор Достоевский, «Бедные люди».
exercises.context: обежа́ть** — **обега́ть — to run around .mw-parser-output .object-usage-tag{font-style:italic}.mw-parser-output .deprecated{color:var(--wikt-palette-grey-lime-8,olivedrab)}[with accusative or вокру́г (vokrúg, + genitive) ‘a location’];…

exercises.q: Эти бестии ___ (обходить / обойти — to go around, to bypass) со стороны рынка.

exercises.context: обойти́** — **обходи́ть — to go around, to bypass (to pass by going around); to walk through, to wander around, to go around, to tour, to go to (many places in an area).

exercises.q: Мать вышла во двор, ___ (обойти / обходить — to go around, to bypass) кругом избушку.
exercises.why: **о-, об-, обо-** — Movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place — Девочка обошла лужу. — The little girl walked around the puddle. Я обхожу все магазины в центре. — I'm going around to all the stores in the mall. — вокруг + gen.; without preposition + acc.. **из-, изо-, ис-** — Movement involving the entire area concerned and carried out in all directions; only formed from multidirectional verb of motion — Я изъездил весь мир. — I traveled over the whole world. — without preposition + acc.. — DLI, Lesson 62.  ·  From Аркадий Гайдар, «Чук и Гек».
exercises.context: о-, об-, обо- — Movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place — Девочка обошла лужу. — The little girl walked around the puddle.
